name: @sherlockmen/hello-my-agent
description: Hello, My Agent：从 0 到 npm 发布，亲手构建你的 TUI Coding Agent

scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm link --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tests/verify-install.mjs
